prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.4%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Control Quickstart Flow: Add an interactive shortcut guide on the final welcome screen demonstrating right-click controls, dragging, and tray hiding. (why: 3 support tickets report user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet after onboarding completes.)
1: [choose_path, copy] Instant Adoption Vs Custom Companion Benefit Microcopy: Explicitly state setup duration estimates (30 sec Instant vs 2 min Custom) directly within the choose_path path descriptions. (why: Choose_path step mean time is 514s despite 86.2% conversion, indicating user hesitation when comparing onboarding paths.)
2: [home, wait_info] Live Desktop Environment Preparation Checklist: Replace waiting screen text with a real-time system preparation checklist monitoring graphics rendering and taskbar placement. (why: Home waiting stage has median time of 201s (mean 2336s) and causes user drop-off due to launch uncertainty.)
3: [finish, notification] Companion Wake-Up Taskbar Notification Banner: Show a high-visibility taskbar status notification on home_intro indicating exactly where the pet is active on the screen. (why: Finish conversion drops to 68.9% with mean duration of 5815s; users get stuck locating active pets.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Split Stage Companion Preview Path Layout: Switch choose_path screen to a split stage layout displaying live companion motion previews alongside path options. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s; visual side-by-side previews help users select quicker.)
